events.public_title: Would escalation force Russia to capitulate in Ukraine?
events.technical_question: Will Trump's Kellogg-style escalation-to-deescalate produce Russian capitulation in Ukraine negotiations?
events.anchor_quote: Kellogg escalation "not going to happen absolutely not going to happen."
events.public_summary: Freeman rejected the idea that Washington could escalate military pressure and thereby force Russia into capitulation.
events.why_it_matters: This prediction tests a recurring Washington assumption: that more weapons, tighter sanctions, or higher pressure can force a strategic climbdown by a great power.
